title: Nyimbo (Theme 4: Aina za maliasili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child places the nyimbo in its kind and occasion, explains its maana with an example, and presents it with the audience taking part.

floor.prerequisite: Tells a riddle or a story with the formula.
floor.question: Kitendawili! - ?

representations: a recording or a performance of "Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala"
steps: Listen to or read the text.
Explain its maana with an example.
contexts: an evening of stories at home

board.do: Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala

board.say: Hii ni nyimbo ya aina gani, na inatumika lini?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child presents a short piece with the class responding.

misconceptions.ask: Hutumika lini, na kwa lengo gani?
misconceptions.repair: "Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala" ni bembelezi: mtoto atulie na alale kwa amani.

misconceptions.ask: Ilipokezwa kwa maandishi au kwa mdomo?
misconceptions.repair: Nyimbo ni fasihi simulizi: hupokezwa kwa mdomo.
Bembelezi hutumika mama anapombembeleza mtoto alale.

listen_for: Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala
misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe ni funzo kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.

checks.question: "Lala mtoto lala, mama yuaja, lala" ni nyimbo ya aina gani?
